name: FreshTab
description: FreshTab is an on-the-fly table-to-text generation benchmark sourced from Wikipedia to address LLM training data contamination and domain imbalance. It supports multiple languages and enables domain-sensitive evaluation of table-to-text generation models.
reputation: A very recent benchmark proposed to address contamination and domain imbalance in table-to-text evaluation, so it is not yet widely established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Addresses LLM data contamination and domain imbalance; supports multiple languages; domain-balanced benchmark is more challenging.
